[SWS_Fee_00154]
Upstream requirements: SRS_MemHwAb_14014
⌈Upon the successful end of the block write operation, the block shall be marked as
"not corrupted" (again).⌋
Note: This internal management information should not be mixed up with the validity
information of a block which can be manipulated by using the Fee_InvalidateBlock
service, i.e. the FEE shall be able to distinguish between a corrupted block and a block
that has been deliberately invalidated by the upper layer.
